payload.abstract: Available here is a gold standard corpus of 2,434 nursing notes that have been thoroughly deidentified by a multi-pass process that included meticulous reviews by three or more experts working independently, as well as by a variety of automated methods. All detected instances of PHI in these nursing notes have been replaced by realistic surrogate data. The gold standard corpus is currently available only to those who have been granted access to PhysioNet Clinical Databases.

dua.name: PhysioNet Credentialed Health Data Use Agreement 1.5.0

payload.short_description: Gold standard corpus of 2,434 deidentified nursing notes
